# Sell 80.00 USD out of Assets:Bank:USD stating the customer's credit as the
# cost basis it draws on. `{basis}` is the credit's split.
#
# Refused. The credit is a liability cost basis, 100.00 USD owed back to the
# customer, and a sale out of the bank spends dollars the book holds; a
# disposal of dollars held draws on an asset cost basis (Q-054). The dollars
# that arrived with the overpayment are the bank's own asset cost basis, and a
# sale of them states that one
# (`fx_sell_80_usd_the_overpayment_brought_into_the_bank.txt`).
#
# Load after `fx_invoice_usd_overpaid_into_usd_bank.txt`.
#
# Verified by
# tests/integration/test_an_overpaid_invoices_dollars_are_sold_against_a_cost_basis_of_their_side.py.
2026-02-28 * "Sell 80 USD of the credit"
	currency.mnemonic: "CAD"
	Assets:Bank:USD -80.00 USD
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
		share_price: "1.40"
		value: "-112.00"
		cost_basis_split_guid: "{basis}"
	Assets:Bank 112.00 CAD
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
		share_price: "1"
		value: "112.00"
